payload_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted UTF8 path TAB sha256 TAB byte_count LF; exact Git-index bytes
receipt_excluded: manifest.json and remote_verification.json excluded to avoid circular hashing. Exact published payload revision is named by the separate anonymous remote receipt.
acceptance: No remaining identified character/composition defect in final scoped AI review. Print-resolution/trim/owner/child/SLP acceptance remains open; no game/release changes.
